The build plate is a dark, speckled material.
A large black filament spool is mounted on the gantry.
The control panel on the right side of the build plate has a rotary dial and two buttons.
The machine is shown in a clean, well-lit indoor environment.
No photos show the underside of the machine, the filament spool, or the power cable.

The spool is shown, but the weight is not visible in the photos.
No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

risks.risk: The printer may not power on or may have a faulty print head.
risks.proof: A video of the printer powering on and successfully printing a test object.

risks.risk: The filament may be a different type (e.g., PETG) or the weight may be significantly lower than 1kg.
risks.proof: A photo of the filament spool with a clear weight label.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic filament of unknown weight

risks.risk: The build plate may be scratched or have a damaged surface.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the build plate surface.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged build plate

risks.risk: The machine may have mechanical issues such as a jammed print head or failed stepper motors.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer completing a successful print cycle.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the filament spool with a clear weight label.
Video of the printer powered on and printing a test object.
Photo of the underside of the machine to check for damage or missing parts.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
